scope: Primary-page verification and editorial topic mapping for bilingual personalised practice reports; not video playback, paid-product hands-on testing, clinical assessment or psychometric validation.

editorialPolicy.selection: Select only resources related to the priority skill/path; cap cards in a report. Prefer practical free instruction, with optional books separately labelled. No affiliate parameters, sponsor ranking, revenue promise or purchase requirement.
editorialPolicy.languages: language records the verified primary teaching-page language. English resources retain their English label in the Turkish UI. Bilingual card titles/descriptions are Freq editorial explanations, not claims of an externally published translation. Video spoken language/captions were not directly checked.
editorialPolicy.cost: free means the verified reference or exercise page is publicly accessible without a payment gate. It does not imply all products mentioned on the site are free or that every licensed material may be commercially redistributed. Paid book candidates with insufficient primary evidence were excluded. One optional commercial mixing book is included after authoritative full library bibliographic verification; its card explicitly separates metadata from the book text and says current price/availability were not checked.
editorialPolicy.technique: Each of 20 guides supplies a listening cue, three actions, a short suggested session, a practical transfer task and a check with unheard examples. Sessions of 5–8 minutes and five-question checks are editorial workflow suggestions, not validated optimal dosages or mastery cut-offs.
editorialPolicy.limits: Fresh-source practice outside the app extends beyond the existing material. No general mastery, guaranteed exam success, clinical hearing status, absolute sound-pressure, or device-latency measurement is inferred.
